That squirrel has been mocking me from the same branch for 47 minutes. This is not over.
The mail carrier came again. I handled it.
I have been sitting in this sunbeam for two hours and I regret nothing.
Someone moved my spot on the couch. I will be staging a formal protest at 3am.
I heard the word 'bath' from three rooms away. I am already under the bed.
They said 'walkies' but then put on their coat and left without me. I am filing a grievance.
The treat fell behind the fridge. I have been staring at the fridge since Tuesday.
There is a new dog in the neighborhood. I have assessed the situation. The situation is unacceptable.
I do not know why they go to the vet. I do not ask questions about their personal lives either.
I found a smell near the park bench that changed my understanding of the world. I cannot explain further.
They called me 'a good boy' in that voice and I pretended not to care. I cared.
The vacuum is back. It has returned. It is never truly gone.
I have been offered a smaller treat in exchange for the original treat. I will not be negotiating.
Someone rang the doorbell on the television. I addressed it. I would address it again.
I dreamed I caught the squirrel. In the dream, I was not sure what to do next. I still won.
They are eating something and looking at me with what I can only describe as disrespect.
I have been asked to get off the bed. I have considered the request.
The baby visited again. I am monitoring the situation.
A leaf blew past the window. I had words with it.
They put a sweater on me. I wore it with great dignity and I want that on record.
It is raining. I have been told this is 'just water.' So is the bath. I see what is happening here.
Snow arrived overnight. I ate some of it. I have no further comment at this time.
The sky made the loud noise again. I have relocated to the bathtub until further notice.
It is too hot to be a dog today. I am lying on the kitchen tile in protest.
The leaves are falling. I have personally inspected forty of them. None were squirrels.
First warm day of spring. I rolled in something. It was worth it. I will not be elaborating.
The wind took my favorite stick. I watched it go. Some things you have to let go.
They opened a window and a smell came in. I have been standing here processing it for eleven minutes.
Dinner is at 6. It is 5:52. I have begun my preparations by staring at the bowl.
They ate a sandwich without me. I have notified everyone in the house, loudly.
A single pea fell on the floor. I got there first. I always get there first.
I ate my breakfast in four seconds. I do not know where it went. I would like a second breakfast.
They opened the cheese drawer. I heard it from upstairs. I am now downstairs.
Someone said 'chicken' on the phone. I came running. It was not about me. I am embarrassed.
They offered me a carrot. I accepted it to be polite. I am not a rabbit.
The crumbs under the toddler's chair are my pension plan.
I took a nap. Then I took a nap from that nap. Productive day.
I was asleep and they said my name. I opened one eye. That is all they get.
I spun around three times before lying down. The fourth spin was for luck.
I dreamed about running. My legs ran too. I woke up very tired from the run I did not go on.
They made the bed. I have unmade it. We each have our jobs.
The sunbeam moved. I moved with it. This is my career now.
It is 3am. I heard a noise. I barked once to let the noise know I am aware of it.
Everyone is asleep. I am on guard. I am also on the couch, which is not allowed. Both can be true.
The moon is out. I looked at it for a while. It did not look back. Rude.
Something walked past the house at midnight. I have decided it was a bear. I saved everyone.
The cat next door sat on the fence and looked at me. I do not know what she wants. I will never know.
A bird landed on the porch railing. We made eye contact. I lost.
There is a frog in the yard. I am not sure if it is a toy. I have decided to keep my distance.
A second squirrel has appeared. They are organizing. I am outnumbered but not outmatched.
I met a very small dog on the walk. It was very loud. I respected it.
A duck at the pond would not acknowledge me. I barked my name twice. Nothing.
The neighbor's cat has been inside our house. I can smell it. I am taking this to the highest levels.
The dishwasher is making the noise again. I am keeping an eye on it.
There is a dog in the mirror. He looks exactly like me. I don't trust him.
The robot vacuum has learned my nap schedule. This feels deliberate.
The washing machine is on spin. I have given it a wide berth. It knows what it did.
Someone dropped a pan. I was not scared. I left the room for unrelated reasons.
The ceiling fan is spinning. It has been spinning for an hour. Where is it going?
My squeaky toy no longer squeaks. I did that. I am not sorry, but I miss it.
We got in the car. I did not know where we were going. It was the best day of my life.
The car window was down. The world smelled like 900 things at once. I need to lie down.
We drove past the dog park and did not stop. I have questions.
The car went to the vet. I would like to file a formal complaint with the car.
Car ride today. I sat in the front seat for one minute before I was demoted.
Someone came to the door. It was a stranger. Then it was my best friend. It took about four seconds.
Grandma is visiting. Grandma does not follow the treat rules. Grandma is my favorite.
A guest sat in my spot. I sat next to them and leaned. They moved. Diplomacy works.
They put on the shoes that mean they are leaving. I have put on my face that means they are not.
They came home. I had to bring them something. I brought a sock. It was the right call.
The keys jingled. My heart stopped. It was a false alarm. I need a minute.
They have been looking at a small glowing rectangle for two hours. I am right here.
There is a tree in the living room now. I was not consulted.
Everyone is wearing paper hats. I have been given a paper hat. I am choosing to allow it.
Fireworks again. I do not know who keeps starting this war, but I am under the bed until it ends.
They gave me a present. I unwrapped it faster than anyone. The present was a ball. I already love it.
Children in costumes came to the door all night asking for treats. I also want treats. Nobody gave me any.
They said it was my birthday. I do not know what that is, but there was cake and I am in favor.
What if the ball doesn't want to be thrown? I think about this sometimes. Then they throw it and I forget.
I have been a dog for my entire life. It has gone well so far.
Sometimes I bark at nothing so nothing knows I'm here.
Where does the tennis ball go when it goes under the couch? Is it still a ball if I can't reach it?
Every walk is the first walk. I do not know how they do the same walk every day and stay so calm.
I chased my tail today. I caught it. Now what?
The human sneezed. I came to check. Everyone is fine. You're welcome.
I lay at their feet while they worked. Not because I like them. Because the floor is warm there.
They were sad today. I put my head on their knee. I don't know what I fixed, but something got better.
They called me 'the best boy in the world.' The world is big. I will accept the title anyway.
I followed them from room to room today. It was for security reasons. Not because I missed them.
They hugged me for a long time. I tolerated it. I would like to tolerate it again soon.
I waited by the door all day. When they came back, I did not cry. I made a high-pitched noise for unrelated reasons.
They gave the cat on TV more attention than me. I sat directly in front of the TV.
The leash came out. Then it went back. I have never felt so betrayed by an object.
Today's walk had seven new smells, two old ones, and one I'm still thinking about.
There was a puddle on the walk. I walked around it. Who knows where it's been.
We met another dog on the walk. We sniffed each other. We understood each other completely.
They used the word 'bath.' I don't think they knew I was in the room. I did not go to the bath.
I have been brushed. I look majestic. Nobody has said so yet.
I was given a bone. I buried it. I do not remember where. This is somehow my fault.
I don't need a reason to bark. That was a short thought, but I meant it.
